title: TB skin test: 15 mm is positive with no known risk factor
summary: A TB skin test with 15 mm or more of induration is positive in people with no known risk factors for TB.

criteria.quote: Classification of TB skin test reactions
The skin test reaction should be read between 48 and 72 hours after administration by a health care worker trained to read TB skin results.
An induration of 15 or more millimeters is considered positive in:
People with no known risk factors for TB
criteria.note: no known risk factor is an absence, which a vignette's findings cannot show

conclusion.quote: An induration of 15 or more millimeters is considered positive in:
asks: interpretation of this TB skin test result
interpretation of the TB skin test
